title: Cut the remaining import tariffs to zero
action: Reduce Australia's remaining statutory import tariffs to zero.
why: Remaining tariffs raise the cost of imported inputs and consumer goods, protect a few local producers at the expense of everyone else, and cost more to administer than many of them raise.

evidence.source: 5-year Productivity Inquiry: Advancing Prosperity, Recommendations and Reform Directives
evidence.quote: reducing Australia's statutory import tariff levels to zero

progress.what: Several hundred low-value 'nuisance' tariffs were abolished from 1 July 2024.
